### streaming: bitrate(6000, 60) = 100 — STREAMING — DELIVERING MEDIA, AS ARITHMETIC (chosen by the public-API registry, not by hand). ### supplychain: leadtime(10, 17) = 7 — SUPPLYCHAIN — MOVING GOODS, AS ARITHMETIC (chosen by the registry, not by hand). ### swaps: fixedleg(10000, 500) = 500 — SWAPS — AN INTEREST-RATE SWAP AS ARITHMETIC.
